stages.name: NASCENT
stages.summary: Raw input has arrived and awaits classification.

stages.name: DECLARED
stages.summary: Identity is assigned and meaning is being resolved.

stages.name: CANONICAL
stages.summary: Meaning is singular; requirements are about to be checked.

stages.name: GATED
stages.summary: Requirements have been evaluated and the gateway knows what is missing or satisfied.

stages.name: REFINABLE
stages.summary: The request is structurally incomplete but safe refinements can move it forward.

stages.name: EXECUTABLE
stages.summary: The command or internal operation is armed and ready to run.
notes: In the seven-class architecture this stage sits at the GATED to SEALED boundary.
The current CLI does not expose a long-lived SEALED stage because execution begins immediately after arming.

stages.name: STABILIZED
stages.summary: The result has been recorded into a stable receipt surface.
